title: Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000 The Swiss bank estimates bitcoin could hit a new all-time high near $128,000 and calls the current downturn the shallowest bear market to date, as bitcoin moves into reserve portfolios. This post Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
